name: Dividend Calendar
description: Upcoming dividends for your holdings: next 12 months by asset and by month, from provider history (projected) and Yahoo calendar events (declared).
author: z1pp090

permissions.purpose: List accounts to gather holdings across the whole portfolio
Read current holdings (symbol, quantity, price, cost) to estimate upcoming payouts
Read instrument type and ISIN to skip non-equity assets and find the primary listing
Read each holding's dividend history to infer payment cadence and last amount
Look up the primary (US) listing and its declared dividends on Yahoo Finance (search + chart endpoints)
Register the Dividend Calendar page in the sidebar
